description: Azure Local (Azure Stack HCI) Well-Architected Framework Assessment Configuration

reliability.name: Reliability
reliability.assessment: Evaluation of high availability, redundancy, and failover capabilities

checks.name: Multi-node clusters for high availability
checks.description: Clusters with 2+ nodes provide redundancy and high availability
checks.passMessage: ✓ All clusters ({multiNodeClusters} of {totalClusters}) have 2+ nodes for high availability
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {multiNodeClusters} of {totalClusters} clusters have 2+ nodes - single-node clusters lack redundancy
checks.failMessage: ✗ No multi-node clusters detected - deploy at least 2 nodes per cluster for HA
checks.recommendation: Deploy clusters with at least 2-3 nodes for high availability and automatic failover capabilities

checks.name: Node connectivity status
checks.description: All nodes should maintain connected status for optimal reliability
checks.passMessage: ✓ All nodes ({connectedNodes} of {totalNodes}) are connected and healthy
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {connectedNodes} of {totalNodes} nodes connected - investigate disconnected nodes
checks.failMessage: ✗ Only {connectedNodes} of {totalNodes} nodes connected - critical availability issue
checks.recommendation: Investigate and resolve connectivity issues with disconnected nodes immediately

checks.name: Workload distribution
checks.description: VMs should be distributed evenly across nodes for better resilience
checks.passMessage: ✓ Virtual machines are evenly distributed across nodes for optimal resilience
checks.failMessage: ⚠ Unbalanced VM distribution - consider redistributing workloads for better resilience
checks.recommendation: Rebalance VM placement across nodes to ensure even resource utilization and failover capacity

security.name: Security
security.description: Protection against security threats and maintaining compliance
security.assessment: Evaluation of security controls, updates, and compliance measures

checks.name: System updates applied
checks.description: Nodes should have latest security updates installed
checks.passMessage: ✓ {upToDateNodes} of {totalNodes} nodes are up to date with latest patches
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {upToDateNodes} of {totalNodes} nodes up to date - apply pending updates
checks.failMessage: ✗ {upToDateNodes} of {totalNodes} nodes up to date - critical security risk
checks.recommendation: Apply available security updates to all nodes following your maintenance schedule

checks.name: Arc monitoring agents deployed
checks.description: Monitoring agents enable security visibility and compliance
checks.passMessage: ✓ All nodes ({nodesWithAgents} of {totalNodes}) have monitoring agents deployed
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {nodesWithAgents} of {totalNodes} nodes have monitoring agents - deploy to all nodes
checks.failMessage: ✗ {nodesWithAgents} of {totalNodes} nodes have monitoring agents - limited visibility
checks.recommendation: Deploy Arc monitoring agents to all nodes for comprehensive security visibility

checks.name: Arc extensions deployed
checks.description: Arc extensions enable security, monitoring, and management capabilities
checks.passMessage: ✓ {nodesWithExtensions} nodes have Arc extensions deployed for enhanced management
checks.failMessage: ⚠ Limited Arc extensions deployment - consider adding security and monitoring extensions
checks.recommendation: Deploy Arc extensions for Azure Monitor, Defender, and Update Management

costOptimization.name: Cost Optimization
costOptimization.description: Managing costs while maximizing infrastructure value
costOptimization.assessment: Evaluation of licensing efficiency and cost optimization opportunities

checks.name: Azure Hybrid Benefit utilization
checks.description: Hybrid Benefit provides FREE licensing ($10/core saved per month)
checks.passMessage: ✓ All nodes ({nodesWithHybridBenefit} of {totalNodes}) use Azure Hybrid Benefit - maximizing cost savings
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {nodesWithHybridBenefit} of {totalNodes} nodes use Hybrid Benefit - potential savings: ${potentialMonthlySavings}/month
checks.failMessage: ✗ Only {nodesWithHybridBenefit} of {totalNodes} nodes use Hybrid Benefit - enable to save ${potentialMonthlySavings}/month
checks.recommendation: Enable Azure Hybrid Benefit on all eligible nodes to eliminate per-core licensing costs

checks.name: Efficient resource utilization
checks.description: Resource allocation should match workload requirements
checks.passMessage: ✓ Average {avgCoresPerNode} cores per node supports good workload density
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ Average {avgCoresPerNode} cores per node - consider workload consolidation
checks.recommendation: Optimize core count per node based on workload density and performance requirements

checks.name: VM distribution and consolidation
checks.description: Balanced VM distribution enables efficient resource usage
checks.passMessage: ✓ Balanced VM distribution enables efficient resource utilization
checks.failMessage: ⚠ Unbalanced VM distribution - consolidation may reduce costs
checks.recommendation: Rebalance workloads to maximize resource efficiency and potentially reduce node count

performance.name: Performance Efficiency
performance.description: Maintaining optimal system performance and scalability
performance.assessment: Evaluation of resource capacity and performance optimization

checks.name: Adequate memory per node
checks.description: Nodes should have sufficient RAM for workload demands
checks.passMessage: ✓ All nodes ({nodesWithSufficientMemory} of {totalNodes}) have 64GB+ RAM for adequate performance
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {nodesWithSufficientMemory} of {totalNodes} nodes have 64GB+ RAM - consider memory upgrades
checks.failMessage: ✗ {nodesWithSufficientMemory} of {totalNodes} nodes have 64GB+ RAM - insufficient for production workloads
checks.recommendation: Ensure nodes have at least 64GB RAM for standard workloads, 128GB+ for high-density scenarios

checks.name: Sufficient CPU cores
checks.description: Adequate CPU resources for workload processing
checks.passMessage: ✓ All nodes ({nodesWithMultipleCores} of {totalNodes}) have 16+ cores for good compute capacity
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {nodesWithMultipleCores} of {totalNodes} nodes have 16+ cores - assess capacity
checks.failMessage: ✗ {nodesWithMultipleCores} of {totalNodes} nodes have 16+ cores - may limit workload capacity
checks.recommendation: Deploy nodes with at least 16 physical cores for standard workloads

checks.name: Storage infrastructure
checks.description: Adequate storage paths for performance and capacity
checks.passMessage: ✓ {totalStoragePaths} storage path(s) configured for VM storage
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ Limited storage paths - ensure adequate capacity and performance
checks.recommendation: Configure multiple storage paths for optimal performance and capacity

operationalExcellence.name: Operational Excellence
operationalExcellence.description: Operations processes for monitoring, management, and automation
operationalExcellence.assessment: Evaluation of operational practices and management infrastructure

checks.name: Software version tracking
checks.description: Cluster software versions should be documented and tracked
checks.passMessage: ✓ All clusters ({clustersWithVersion} of {totalClusters}) report software version for lifecycle management
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {clustersWithVersion} of {totalClusters} clusters report version - improve tracking
checks.failMessage: ✗ No cluster version information available - implement version tracking
checks.recommendation: Maintain accurate software version tracking for lifecycle and update management

checks.name: Monitoring agents deployed
checks.passMessage: ✓ All nodes ({nodesWithMonitoring} of {totalNodes}) have monitoring agents for operational visibility
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ {nodesWithMonitoring} of {totalNodes} nodes have monitoring - deploy to all nodes
checks.failMessage: ✗ {nodesWithMonitoring} of {totalNodes} nodes have monitoring - limited operational visibility
checks.recommendation: Deploy monitoring agents to all nodes for comprehensive operational insights

checks.name: Arc Resource Bridge deployment
checks.description: Arc Resource Bridge enables advanced Azure management capabilities
checks.passMessage: ✓ {totalArcBridges} Arc Resource Bridge(s) deployed for Azure integration
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ No Arc Resource Bridges - limited Azure management capabilities
checks.recommendation: Deploy Arc Resource Bridge to enable VM lifecycle management from Azure portal

checks.name: Logical Network configuration
checks.description: Logical networks enable VM connectivity and network management
checks.passMessage: ✓ {totalLogicalNetworks} logical network(s) configured for VM connectivity
checks.failMessage: ⚠ No logical networks configured - VMs may have limited connectivity
checks.recommendation: Configure logical networks to provide proper network connectivity for VMs

checks.name: Custom Locations for workload placement
checks.description: Custom Locations enable Azure-native resource deployment
checks.passMessage: ✓ {totalCustomLocations} Custom Location(s) enable Azure-native resource deployment
checks.warningMessage: ⚠ No Custom Locations - limited Azure integration
checks.recommendation: Create Custom Locations to enable Azure resource deployment to your Azure Local infrastructure

scoring.description: Each check has a weight (1-3) representing its importance. Score = (passed weights + warning weights * 0.5) / total weights * 100

messages.excellent: ✅ Excellent! Your Azure Local deployment follows most Well-Architected Framework best practices.
messages.good: ⚠️ Good! Your deployment follows many best practices, but there are opportunities for improvement.
messages.needsImprovement: ❌ Your deployment needs improvement. Address the failed checks to align with best practices.
messages.poor: ❌ Critical issues detected. Immediate action required to align with Well-Architected Framework principles.
